$comment: Decision 0018 (gate G5). THE DEFAULT. Modelled on the Association of Boxing Commissions' Unified Rules of Boxing, which contain no three-knockdown rule (Rule 8), no standing eight count (Rule 7), a mandatory eight count after every knockdown (Rule 5), and no saved-by-the-bell in any round (Rule 10). This is not a copy of that rulebook - it is Project Uppercut's own professional ruleset, authored to agree with it where this project models the same thing. A bout under these rules ends because a fighter could not continue, or because the cards said so.
name: Project Uppercut Professional Rules

referee_stoppage.note: A referee may stop a bout on judgement, and under these rules that is the only discretionary stoppage - there is no knockdown count to end one automatically. This project does not yet model referee judgement, so under this ruleset a bout currently ends only by the cards or by a fighter failing the count. That is a gap in the implementation, not in the rules, and it is stated here so that a bout going the distance is not mistaken for a bout that could not have been stopped.

notes: Selected as the default by Decision 0018. Consequence stated there and worth repeating: every stoppage figure measured before 2026-08-05 was measured under the arcade three-knockdown termination and must be re-run rather than re-read.
